newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up further offshore, interbank firmer.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up further offshore, interbank firmer.

text.p: The Thai baht rallied further in offshore market in late Monday trade as foreign players continued selling dollars to raise funds for covering their short-baht positions, dealers said.

The baht rose to 24.750/24.850 to the dollar late in offshore market from 24.800/24.900 early in the morning. The baht remained steady at 25.820/25.850 in the domestic market against 25.820/25.840 earlier.
"Strong demand for baht persisted in offshore market. But in local market, trade remain quiet as usual," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate at 25.81 baht to the dollar against 25.80 on Friday.
Dealers said costly baht fundings in the forward market prompted offshore players to dump dollars for baht in the spot market.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium hovered at 100/140 satangs per dollar late in offshore market against 120/140 in the early morning, dealers said.
In the domestic market, the one-month swap premium was quoted at 20/35 satangs against 20/30 early in the morning.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 14.00-15.00 percent late from 13.00-14.00 in the morning on tightened liquidity, dealers said.
Dealers said the start of corporate tax payment raised domestic demand for baht, dealers said.
